item1.question: What is Clash of Clans Tracker?
item1.answer: It is a progress tracker for Clash of Clans. It helps you manage multiple accounts and track your upgrades, achievements, dailies and overall progress in one place.

item2.question: How does it store my data?
item2.answer: Everything is saved in your browser, so your progress is private and needs no account. You can export and import it as a JSON file for backup. The optional player tag lookup sends the tag to a small server action that asks the Supercell API for your public stats.

item3.question: Can I track multiple villages?
item3.answer: Yes. Create as many villages as you like, each with its own progress, and switch between them in the sidebar.

item4.question: Does it sync across devices?
item4.answer: Yes, if you want it to. Open Settings and connect GitHub, Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive. Your data is stored in your own account, and syncing stays off until you turn it on.

item5.question: Is this app free to use?
item5.answer: Yes. It is free, with no subscription, no ads and no sign up.

final.title: Start tracking your villages today
final.description: No account and no sign up. Your first village takes one name.
